text_block_list.text:
It happened during the final adjustments 
for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Tsurumaru-san. Tense up your 
shoulders and arms~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Gonna pull it all out at once~ Reach out 
and wiggle, wiggle, wiggle~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Swish, swish, swish~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho. Yes, the reaction around the 
arms is good too—oh?
(Woooooaaah!)

Regarding the cause of that, notice was 
given yesterday. They had suddenly granted 
press access exclusively during this hour 
today.

For the sake of that Umamusume who 
repainted the world overnight.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa! Thank you for your hard 
work in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! 
Thank you for giving us a historic dream!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What are your future plans!? Will domestic 
fans have a chance to see those legs that 
just returned from France in action!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...YES, dat is true~ Whoops—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haha—...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Tsuru-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—!? El-chan!? You were over there just a 
second ago—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, I just couldn't wait! I simply 
had to talk with you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Tsuru-chan. Did you... defeat Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: My win wasn't a fluke, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In the next Tenno Sho (Autumn) as well, I 
will defeat Spe-chan once again.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Sei-chan, King-chan, and every single 
Umamusume who steps onto that same stage— 
I'll overpower every last one of them with 
my legs!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, hehehehe! Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! Could this be a reenactment 
of the Classic Triple Crown?! Vying for 
the title of the strongest on the grandest 
stage of all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Such a stage... How enviable.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *wheeze*... El Condor 
Pasa-san... Could you perhaps be 
interested in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—I am interested! However, please look at 
El right now!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am totally, completely wiped out!! I'll 
be taking a break for a little while!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehh~!? You don't look tired in the 
slightest, though...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Then will you come after your break?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's true that El needs some rest, desu. 
I'll probably only be able to show myself 
to everyone once this year.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm expecting great things from you, you 
know? All the way to the very end.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Alrighty then, ciao~!

El Condor Pasa departs. As if stepping out 
of a wrestling ring, she places her hands 
on the outer rail of the track—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: S-She jumped...!?

Leaving everything behind, it disappeared 
beyond the stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, it's already time for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)! A prestigious battle for the 
Autumn Shield, today's winner will be...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky! Definitely Sky! She was in top 
shape this summer too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ha. In terms of both data and romance, 
it's gotta be Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi here. I'm 
betting on that late burst from the Kyoto 
Daishoten...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Not a chance! Today's the day Mejiro 
Bright brings the Autumn Shield home to 
the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph, nobody gets it! Spe-chan is totally 
gonna win...!"

The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn). The 
surging anticipation from the fans could 
be felt even down in the paddock tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Apparently, we are the 'Golden 
Generation.'

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Competing for the strongest title both at 
home and abroad, making every single race 
impossible to look away from... ...They 
say it was truly a generational treasure.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"This Tenno Sho (Autumn) looks like it'll 
be an unforgettable race, not just for me, 
but for everyone."

Though Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi speaks with a 
bright, cheerful demeanor, deep down lurks 
an insatiable thirst for victory.
choice_data_list:
Let's become a strong Umamusume who can 
beat anyone.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will. Stronger than anyone, just 
like the President.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —That is my potential!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...My, my, Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's starting again today, our race.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Everyone's watching. On this stage 
where all eyes are upon us—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Let's run.
